christmas-toy-factory.title: Christmas Toy Factory
christmas-toy-factory.description: A workshop full of tiny toys. Sort the parts, build a little joy, and wrap it up.

Cookie_Shape_3D.title: Cookie Shape 3D
Cookie_Shape_3D.description: Freshly baked brain teasers. Match the cookie pieces and find that perfect fit.

slot-sorting.title: Slot Sorting
slot-sorting.description: Slide the pipes, connect each colorful path, and guide every ball into its matching bin across 16 tropical puzzles.

Letter_Press.title: Letter Press
Letter_Press.description: A playful twist on word puzzles. Pick your letters and press them into place.

Ironroot_Convoy.title: Ironroot Convoy
Ironroot_Convoy.description: Ride a pixel war-wagon from station to station. Pick weapons, carriages and heroes, then hold the line against waves and bosses.

Fantasy_Puzzle.title: Fantasy Puzzle
Fantasy_Puzzle.description: Place six pixel heroes, pick their skills and attack order, then clear every monster in one turn across 60 levels.

Thread_And_Thunder.title: Thread & Thunder
Thread_And_Thunder.description: Swipe through a tangle of threads to set the cloud puffs free, but keep every storm cloud tied down across 44 levels, now with heavy rain clouds the puffs must carry up.

Cable_Grid_Sort.title: Cable Grid Sort
Cable_Grid_Sort.description: Untangle a messy server rack. Unplug and replug each cable into its matching ports without crossings, working around broken sockets across 12 levels.
